Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE transparent cinematic spacecraft sprite for StarChain, enemy tier 11 "远航碟形巡洋舰". Preferred native canvas 1536x1024.
Primary request: A medium-heavy TWO-TIER SAUCER CRUISER, a wide broad flattened silver LOWER DISC supporting a clearly smaller raised UPPER DISC. EXACTLY TWO distinct disc levels, with a small recessed central blue glass dome nested into the upper disc. Six compact peripheral engine pods are evenly integrated around the lower disc circumference as substantial rim modules, visually part of the round hull, not loose appendages. Layered thin violet circular panel seams emphasize the two-level construction. More substantial and complex than a simple small flying saucer, but never a tall stacked citadel, giant station or multi-level tower.
Design: broad low horizontal proportion. Silver-white segmented armor plates, graphite dark machinery in the tier gap and underside, realistic fine seams, subtle weathering. Six evenly spaced integrated peripheral rim engine pods, short recessed violet engine glows with no long trails; perspective may hide portions of the far side. A small forward navigation notch with a cyan-violet light is at the LEFT edge; rear propulsion detail RIGHT. The smaller upper tier occupies roughly 55 percent lower disc diameter, raised only enough to clearly distinguish two levels. Central blue dome is low and partly recessed, no tall bubble cockpit. Clean clearly readable outer saucer silhouette.
Orientation/camera: forward LEFT, horizontal three-quarter view seen slightly from above, visible upper deck and modest dark underside. Full ship entirely visible. Keep all geometry and glow inside central 78 percent width and 70 percent height, at least 8 percent clear transparent margins on every side.
Input image role: reference is for cinematic silver/graphite materials, restrained purple emissive accents, crisp blue glass and cool neutral top-left studio lighting ONLY. Do not copy its winged-fighter geometry.
Style: premium realistic hard-surface sci-fi game spacecraft render, rich dimensional materials, controlled intricate panel detail, practical layered engineering, strong clean silhouette.
Background: true transparent RGBA alpha, clean isolated cutout, no backdrop.
Avoid: single-level simple saucer, three or more disc tiers, tall building, multilevel citadel, space station, winged fighter, narrow long fuselage, torus/ring, spherical probe, humanoid robots, humans, sea or land vehicles, extra spacecraft, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, UI, border, ground, cast shadow, opaque black backdrop, environment, fog halo, long exhaust, laser beams or weapon fire.
